mcp_tools.name: product_metrics_event_taxonomy_pack
mcp_tools.title: Product metrics event taxonomy pack
mcp_tools.description: Submits a product metrics and event taxonomy record (decision and KPI tree, declared metric, event and property rows, data quality, privacy by construction, dashboards, experiments and feedback, red lines) and returns a deterministic PRODUCT_METRICS_EVENT_TAXONOMY_PACK_READY / PRODUCT_METRICS_EVENT_TAXONOMY_PACK_NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed naming-convention, traceability and coverage checks over the declared rows, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared taxonomy record only; it collects no data and judges no product's performance.

inputSchema.description: The product metrics event taxonomy pack manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and row schemas).

expect.notes: All fields present and valid. Computed spot checks: metrics_count=1, events_count=1, properties_count=1, definition_coverage=1.000000, event_property_coverage=1.000000.
